India Increases LPG Production Ahead of Festival Season

India has increased its production of Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) as the festival season approaches. State-owned refineries have begun raising domestic LPG output in anticipation of rising demand during this period. This move aims to ensure adequate supply during the festive season.
